text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, the curtain rises for the spring Tenno Sho—the showdown between Narita Brian and Rice Shower, the Sable Assassin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower seems frail at a glance, but a strong will lies hidden within. Despite being called "the Assassin" and treated like a villain, she doesn't run away from a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling respect for her resilience, Narita Brian puts her entire body and soul into their competition.
